arxiv-2104-01718.title: The birational geometry of ℛ ¯ g , 2 \overline{\mathcal{R}}_{g,2} and Prym-canonical divisorial strata
arxiv-2104-01718.creator: Andrei Bud
arxiv-2104-01718.description: Abstract We prove that the moduli space of double covers ramified at two points ℛ g , 2 \mathcal{R}_{g,2} is uniruled for 3 ≤ g ≤ 6 3\leq g\leq 6 and of general type for g ≥ 16 g\geq 16 .

arxiv-2204-04619.title: A New Framework for Fast Automated Phonological Reconstruction Using Trimmed Alignments and Sound Correspondence Patterns
arxiv-2204-04619.creator: Johann-Mattis List, Robert Forkel, Nathan W. Hill
arxiv-2204-04619.description: Abstract Computational approaches in historical linguistics have been increasingly applied during the past decade and many new methods that implement parts of the traditional comparative method have been proposed. Despite these increased efforts, there are not many easy-to-use and fast approaches for the task of phonological reconstruction.

arxiv-2211-02840.title: Astroparticle Constraints from the Cosmic Star Formation Rate Density at High Redshift: Current Status and Forecasts for JWST
arxiv-2211-02840.creator: Giovanni Gandolfi, Andrea Lapi, Tommaso Ronconi, Luigi Danese
arxiv-2211-02840.description: Abstract We exploit the recent determination of the cosmic star formation rate (SFR) density at high redshifts z ≳ 4 z\gtrsim 4 to derive astroparticle constraints on three common dark matter (DM) scenarios alternative to standard cold dark matter (CDM): warm dark matter (WDM), fuzzy dark matter ( ψ \psi DM) and self-interacting dark matter (SIDM).

Caminha, Amata Mercurio, Ana Acebron, Pietro Bergamini, Claudio Grillo, Piero Rosati, Eros Vanzella, Marco Castellano, Emiliano Merlin, Diego Paris, Kristan Boyett, Antonello Calabrò, Takahiro Morishita, Sara Mas

The demographics of the production and escape of ionizing photons from UV-faint early galaxies is a key unknown in discovering the primary drivers of reionization.

arxiv-2301-10333.title: Lost in Algorithms CCS: Mathematics of computing CCS: Theory of computation Models of computation
arxiv-2301-10333.creator: Andrew N. Sloss
arxiv-2301-10333.description: Abstract . Algorithms are becoming more capable, and with that comes hic sunt dracones ( “here be dragons” ). The term symbolizes areas beyond our known maps. We use this term since we are stepping into an exciting, potentially dangerous, and unknown area with algorithms. Our curiosity to understand the natural world drives our search for new methods.

arxiv-2402-02402.title: Machine Learning Analysis of the Impact of Increasing the Minimum Wage on Income Inequality in Spain from 2001 to 2021
arxiv-2402-02402.creator: Marcos Lacasa Cazcarra
arxiv-2402-02402.description: Abstract This paper analyzes the impact of the National Minimum Wage from 2001 to 2021. The MNW increased from €505.7/month (2001) to €1,108.3/month (2021). Using the data provided by the Spanish Tax Administration Agency, databases that represent the entire population studied can be analyzed. More accurate results and more efficient predictive models are provided by these counts.

arxiv-2502-15476.title: Sheaf theory: from deep geometry to deep learning
arxiv-2502-15476.description: Abstract . This paper provides an overview of the applications of sheaf theory in deep learning, data science, and computer science in general. The primary text of this work serves as a friendly introduction to applied and computational sheaf theory accessible to those with modest mathematical familiarity.

arxiv-2503-07030.title: Sensitivity of Online Feedback Optimization to time-varying parameters
arxiv-2503-07030.creator: Marta Zagorowska, Lars Imsland
arxiv-2503-07030.description: Abstract Online Feedback Optimization uses optimization algorithms as dynamic systems to design optimal control inputs. The results obtained from Online Feedback Optimization depend on the setup of the chosen optimization algorithm. In this work we analyse the sensitivity of Online Feedback Optimization to the parameters of projected gradient descent as the algorithm of choice.

arxiv-2503-11684.title: Exploring Causality for HRI: A Case Study on Robotic Mental Well-being Coaching
arxiv-2503-11684.creator: Micol Spitale, Srikar Babu*, Serhan Çakmak*, Jiaee Cheong, Hatice Gunes
arxiv-2503-11684.description: Abstract One of the primary goals of Human-Robot Interaction (HRI) research is to develop robots that can interpret human behavior and adapt their responses accordingly. Adaptive learning models, such as continual and reinforcement learning, play a crucial role in improving robots’ ability to interact effectively in real-world settings.

arxiv-2508-02672.title: Super-Penrose & \And Witten Transforms for SCFT 3
arxiv-2508-02672.creator: Deep Mazumdar
arxiv-2508-02672.description: Abstract The study of three dimensional CFT correlators in twistor space has recently garnered a significant interest. Conformal symmetry acts linearly in the twistor space, which streamlines the analysis. Moreover, twistors provide a connection to the position and momentum space through the Penrose and Witten transforms, respectively.

arxiv-2510-16007.title: Layer-Aware Influence for Online Data Valuation Estimation
arxiv-2510-16007.creator: Ziao Yang, Longbo Huang, Hongfu Liu
arxiv-2510-16007.description: Abstract Data-centric learning emphasizes curating high-quality training samples to boost performance rather than designing new architectures. A central problem is to estimate the influence of training sample efficiently. Prior studies largely focus on static influence measured on a converged model, overlooking how data valuation dynamically changes during optimization.

pmc-11403275.title: Cross‐cultural adaptation of the empowerment scale of pregnant women in China context: An integrative method of translation and linguistic validation
pmc-11403275.creator: Yanjia Liu, Chong Chin Che, Mukhri Hamdan, Mei Chan Chong
pmc-11403275.description: AimTo translate the Empowerment Scale for Pregnant Women (ESPW) into Chinese and to assess its linguistic validity.MethodsThe integrative method of the translation process, the Delphi technique, and cognitive interviews were used to implement cross‐cultural adaptation and enhance comprehensibility and linguistic validation. This study recruited 14 experts in the expert review and cognitively reviewed 15 pregnant women.

pmc-11622579.title: Vaccine hesitancy among Syrian refugee parents in Canada: A multifaceted challenge in public health
pmc-11622579.creator: Baraa Alghalyini, Abdul Rehman Zia Zaidi, Safoura Zangiabadi, Akm Alamgir, Hala Tamim
pmc-11622579.description: Vaccine hesitancy presents a significant public health challenge, particularly among Syrian refugee parents in Canada, who navigate unique barriers to vaccination. This cross-sectional study explores the determinants of vaccine hesitancy, considering socio-demographic factors, resettlement conditions, health assessments, and healthcare system interactions.

pmc-11907711.title: A rare case of simultaneous spontaneous coronary artery dissections in the circumflex and the right coronary arteries presenting as acute myocardial infarction: a case report
pmc-11907711.creator: Fekher Jaoued, Zied Ben Ameur, Wassim Saoudi, Hedi Frigui, Raouf Kchaou, Wissal Rouatbi, Mohamed Aymen Ben Abdesslam, Samia Ernez Hajri
pmc-11907711.description: Simultaneous Spontaneous Coronary Artery Dissection (SCAD) involving multiple coronary arteries is an exceptionally rare occurrence. We present a unique case of a 55-year-old woman with no known cardiovascular risk factors who presented with severe chest pain and ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI).

pmc-12440721.title: Association between onset age and mortality gradients in advanced cardiovascular–kidney–metabolic syndrome
pmc-12440721.creator: Jinjin Dai, Chuanchang Wu, Shihua Liu, Shuohua Chen, Xiaodan Hong, Pengyue Zhang, Liufu Cui, Shouling Wu, Zhenhua Zhang
pmc-12440721.description: IntroductionAdvanced cardiovascular–kidney–metabolic (A-CKM) syndrome portends severe prognosis, but how onset age affects mortality risk remains unquantified.MethodsThis study analyzed 179,328 participants from the Kailuan cohort in Tangshan, China (2006–2022). Using weighted Cox models and stratified analyses, we assessed the association of age at onset with all-cause mortality risk.

pmc-12524179.title: Improved Murine Model for the Intravital Microscopic Examination of Manifest Tumors
pmc-12524179.creator: Frank Tavassol, Jan Winterboer, Philipp Jehn, Matthias Kappler, Felix Tilsen, Andreas Kampmann
pmc-12524179.description: Animal models are essential for studying tumor pathophysiology; however, most lack the capacity for repeated in vivo observation of tumor growth and vascularization over extended periods. This study aimed to establish a novel in vivo model using the mouse dorsal skinfold chamber.

pmc-13388084.title: The diagnostic efficacy of venous-phase spectral CT combined with Node-RADS for differentiating enlarged lymph nodes in common solid tumors: a preliminary exploratory study
pmc-13388084.creator: Xia Su, Hanhong Xie, Jiatong Liang, Xingxing Xie, Lan Lan, Peng Peng
pmc-13388084.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the value of combining quantitative parameters from spectral CT with the Node Reporting and Data System 1.0 (Node-RADS) in distinguishing between benign and malignant lymph nodes enlarged due to solid tumors, and to explore a combined multiparametric approach.

pmc-13601145.title: De ontwikkeling van een heuristisch Maatschappelijk GezondheidsTransformatie-model op basis van een evaluatie van het programma Alles is Gezondheid
pmc-13601145.creator: Marleen P M Bekker, Laurens M Reumers, Chantal Walg, Maria W J Jansen, Henk B M Hilderink, Jan-Kees Helderman, Dirk Ruwaard
pmc-13601145.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). SamenvattingInleidingDoor het landelijke programma Alles is Gezondheid (AiG) voor het faciliteren van domeinoverstijgende maatschappelijke gezondheidsnetwerken te evalueren onderzoeken we de vraag ‘Hoe kan maatschappelijke gezondheidstransformatie worden geconceptualiseerd en geëvalueerd?’ Theorieën over small wins en sociale verandermechanismen begeleiden de analyse.MethodeTussen 2014 en 2022 werd een meervoudig casusonderzoek uitgevoerd met vier verschillende initiatiefnetwerken aangesloten bij AiG, met 53 semigestructureerde stakeholderinterviews, vijftien observaties van bijeenkomsten, en drie dialoogworkshops ter validering van de bevindingen.ResultatenObservaties leidden tot de formulering van vijf verandermechanismen en vijf transformatieve small wins
